timing_interpretation.nvme_interval: Measured by aggregate direct-I/O service time; physical bytes and plan are identical.
timing_interpretation.h2d_interval: First/last host submissions and first graph start/last graph completion define a delivery envelope. No exclusive device-side H2D completion interval was captured, so delivery_envelope_effective_payload_GBps must not be presented as PCIe transfer-only bandwidth.
timing_interpretation.queued_upload_plus_graph_interval: The expert-graph-ns counter measures host wall inside ggml_backend_graph_compute and includes preceding queued H2D dependencies. It is 63.20 s in both candidate repeats, but no device activity trace separates upload dependency from kernel execution.
timing_interpretation.result_return_interval: Measured host-stage return wall for 947,222,528 bytes over 92 layer returns.
timing_interpretation.event_dependency_wait: Measured separately and negligible (35-38 microseconds aggregate).
timing_interpretation.overlap: The first/last envelopes include storage, uploads, expert graphs and causal scheduling. Their overlap is observable at the envelope level but is not an exclusive HIP activity trace.
timing_interpretation.decisive_term: The candidate queued upload-plus-graph dependency service is about 58.69 s slower than the control. The present evidence does not attribute that delta wholly to IQ1_S arithmetic. Even zero-cost result return cannot approach the preregistered performance gate.

invalid_diagnostic_chronology.cause: The first candidate incorrectly treated valid calibrated-plan exact fallback routes as a provider failure and aborted at layer 3.
invalid_diagnostic_chronology.disposition: The invalid fail-close condition was narrowed; the frozen physical plan itself was not changed.

invalid_diagnostic_chronology.cause: Mixed calibrated/fallback tokens selected gfx1201 source rows directly for the gfx1151 canonical join instead of the returned mirror rows.
invalid_diagnostic_chronology.disposition: The row selection was corrected and the four-arm sequence restarted with one final binary.

invalid_diagnostic_chronology.cause: The raw direct peer-copy return produced repeatable non-reference layer and logits hashes.
invalid_diagnostic_chronology.disposition: A host-stage return discriminator isolated transfer from compute.

invalid_diagnostic_chronology.result: The gfx1201 layer-1 output and final logits became byte-identical to the control when the same gfx1201 arithmetic was returned through host staging. This proves the candidate arithmetic, rather than gfx1201 IQ1_S computation, caused no numerical drift; the raw peer-return mechanism was the corrupting mechanism.

scope: A valid Lane A NO-GO closes only the complete gfx1201 prompt-provider topology at M64 with the current IQ1_S kernels and all macro-union payload crossing PCIe. It does not close concurrent dual-owner expert execution, persistent hot-subset residency, a wider-M crossover, or a different gfx1201 kernel/representation.
next_step: Do not run M1024 and do not build another complete provider. First use recorded expert jobs for a model-free concurrent dual-owner graph census at widths 64, 128, 256, 512 and 1024; measure an ownership partition only if the census earns it.
